purpose: Blind, reproducible evidence that the repaired edition matches the authoritative edition-identical witness; this sample supplements and never replaces total sequential review.

universe.eligible_units: Every deterministic raw author-text block assigned exactly once to one of the 29 canonical documents.
universe.exclusion_rule: No authorial or illegible unit may be excluded. Any excluded unit needs an enumerated non-authorial reason and independent review.

seed.manifest_material: Canonical JSON of the ordered Stage 2 raw allowlist rows, retaining relative_path, role, byte_size, logical_line_count, and sha256 and using UTF-8, sorted object keys, compact separators, and no terminal newline.
seed.ordering: Ascending unsigned 256-bit rank, then raw_block_id as a collision tie-breaker.
stage_2_outputs: the complete pre-repair ordered ranking per canonical document and risk stratum

risk_strata.rule: Any block assigned to the Index or containing an Index entry/subentry/cross-reference region.
Any formula, code, fence, rule table, exact sequence, operator-rich datum, or technical-symbol block.
Any image reference, caption, printed figure group, or text whose ordering/meaning depends on a visual region.
Any heading, page furniture, list/table boundary, paragraph join, column-sensitive, or other structure-bearing block.

stratum_assignment: Assign every eligible block to the first matching risk stratum by ascending priority; record all secondary risk tags separately.

sample_size.small_document_rule: Select all eligible blocks when a document has fewer than 20.
sample_size.risk_allocation: Within each document, allocate the minimum sample proportionally by risk-stratum population using largest remainders, with at least one block from each nonempty high-risk stratum before PROSE when the document quota permits.
sample_size.changed_unchanged_rule: Stage 2 freezes the full ranked lists before repairs. After a repair-overlay digest is sealed, label every ranked block CHANGED or UNCHANGED without altering ranks. Select from each label by the frozen ranks, targeting an even split when both pools permit; include all members of a smaller pool and fill the remainder from the other. Never substitute a lower-ranked block based on its observed answer.
sample_size.all_changed_review: Every changed author-text block is reviewed outside the holdout whether or not selected; the holdout remains an independent quality projection.

blind_protocol.witness_transcription_timing: For selected blocks, record the witness transcription, structure, technical tokens, Index order, and figure/caption association before the adjudicator sees raw OCR or proposed repaired text.
blind_protocol.separation: The witness transcriber/adjudicator identity must differ from the repair creator for changed high-risk blocks.
blind_protocol.blinding: Do not disclose CHANGED/UNCHANGED label, candidate detector output, raw OCR, or proposed repair until the witness decision and evidence-view hash are sealed.
blind_protocol.disagreement: Any disagreement is recorded, independently adjudicated, and blocks closure until resolved from authoritative evidence.
blind_protocol.human_claims: Record HUMAN only when a human actually performed the review; otherwise record the exact agent or automated reviewer type.

severity.definition: Missing, illegible, untranscribed, unowned, or unreviewed authorial page region; unknown edition identity; or a gap/overlap in raw, witness, or repaired provenance.
A mismatch that can change meaning, including a formula/code/data token, Index order, figure/caption ownership, omitted content, duplicated content, or wrong structural boundary.
Any other author-text character, punctuation, typography, paragraph/list/heading, or source-significant layout mismatch.
Broken required navigation, provenance, reversibility, reproducibility, governed asset, role separation, or compatibility behavior without an author-text mismatch.
Optional non-authorial enhancement such as additional editorial commentary or alt-text refinement that is explicitly outside canonical author text.

author_text_character_projection_exactne.definition: Exact Unicode scalar sequence after removing only manifest-typed generated metadata; no normalization, case folding, or whitespace folding.

author_text_cer.definition: Levenshtein character errors divided by authoritative witness character count, reported in addition to exactness.

author_text_wer.definition: Whitespace-token Levenshtein errors divided by authoritative witness token count, reported in addition to exactness.

fixed_point.restart_rule: Discovery of a new defect class resets the consecutive-round count after a detector/manual protocol for that class is added and rerun across all 29 documents.

anti_post_hoc_rules: Do not change the seed, rankings, quotas, severity definitions, metrics, or thresholds after inspecting repair results.
A protocol change reopens Stage 1 and invalidates all downstream sample claims until samples are rematerialized before further repair review.
Tests and detector success do not substitute for the blind authoritative-witness comparison.
